title: Redraw
description: A little space for your next big idea.

dashboard.blackboardDescription: Think out loud. Connect ideas, map a plan, and make sense of the messy middle.
dashboard.canvasDescription: Bring it into focus. Design interfaces, compose visuals, and build something beautiful.
dashboard.emptyHint: Create a Blackboard or Canvas, or try a template above.
dashboard.changeSearch: Try another search or clear your filters.

editor.emptyLayers: Choose a tool and draw your first object.
editor.shortcuts: V select · H pan · R rectangle · T text · P pen. Shift-click to select more. Arrows move; Shift moves 10px. Ctrl/⌘ Z undo, D duplicate, G group. Enter adds a mind-map branch. 0 fits the view.
editor.selectHint: Select an object to adjust its design. Drag its corner to resize.
editor.connectTarget: Now choose the object to connect to
editor.unsavedLeave: This project has unsaved changes. Save or export your draft before leaving.
